id.description: Selected value identifier; mutually exclusive with externalCode.

label.description: Free text or value label; empty is retained.

externalCode.description: Selected value external code; mutually exclusive with id.

value.description: Property value or null to remove it.

propertyId.description: Custom property ID or key; must be unique in this request.

items.description: Custom-property upsert or removal identified by propertyId.

compensation.description: Replacement compensation object; omitted components in this object become unset, not preserved.

max.description: Upper amount or null to unset.

min.description: Lower amount or null to unset.

period.description: Amount period or null to unset.

currency.description: Currency code or null to unset.

departmentId.description: Replacement department or null to clear.

eeoCategoryId.description: Replacement EEO category or null to clear.

targetHiringAt.description: Replacement target hiring instant, at most milliseconds, or null to clear.

referenceNumber.description: Replacement reference or null to clear.

typeOfEmploymentId.description: Replacement employment type or null to clear.

changes.description: Partial modification; omitted fields stay unchanged, null clears nullable fields, and arrays replace their specified values except properties which upsert by key.

FunctionInput_smartrecruiters_api_key_up.description: Identify a job and supply only the content, classification, compensation, or property changes to apply.

status.description: Returned lifecycle state; not an approval-completion guarantee.

FunctionOutput_smartrecruiters_api_key_u.description: Updated job identity and the stored summary fields returned by the provider.

tags.instructions: Use a job ID from `list-jobs` or `get-job`. Omitted changes remain unchanged; nullable classification and content fields use null to clear where supported. Compensation is a supplied replacement object. Use `update-job-status` for lifecycle status and `enable-job-publication` for publication. Changes can trigger approval and always change modification time; do not blindly replay.

functions.name: update-job-application-status
functions.description: Change the recruitment status of a candidate's application to a job, optionally specifying substatus, start instant, or a rejection/withdrawal reason.

reasonId.description: Configured rejection or withdrawal reason ID; only valid with REJECTED or WITHDRAWN.

startsOn.description: Provider startsOn instant with explicit offset; kept distinct from creation time.

subStatus.description: Target configured substatus; omitted to let the provider apply transition rules, not as an explicit clear.

FunctionInput_smartrecruiters_api_key_up.description: One application status transition, with optional configured workflow fields and start instant.

status.description: Target status accepted by the provider; not a fresh application snapshot.

FunctionOutput_smartrecruiters_api_key_u.description: Acknowledgment of the accepted target transition, not a current application snapshot.

tags.instructions: Use candidateId and jobId from `get-candidate-job-application`. This changes one application, not every application for the candidate. Reason IDs and substatuses must come from the account's recruitment configuration. A reason applies only to REJECTED or WITHDRAWN. Use `list-job-application-status-history` to review transitions.

functions.name: update-job-status
functions.description: Change a job's lifecycle status, including sourcing, filled, cancelled, or on hold.

jobId.description: Job whose lifecycle status to change.

status.description: Desired job lifecycle state; OTHER is not writable.

FunctionInput_smartrecruiters_api_key_up.description: Job identifier and desired lifecycle status.

status.description: Status returned by the provider after the update.

FunctionOutput_smartrecruiters_api_key_u.description: Updated job identifier and lifecycle status returned by the provider.

tags.instructions: Use a job ID from `list-jobs`. Use `update-job` for content and `enable-job-publication` or `disable-job-publication` for publication. This changes lifecycle state; do not assume it also changes posting visibility or candidate statuses. Check the current job before replaying an uncertain update.

functions.name: update-review
functions.description: Partially update a review's rating or comment while preserving its reviewer attribution.

reviewerId.description: Existing reviewer ID; must match the review's reviewer.

overallRating.description: Replacement overall rating; omitted preserves it.

comment.description: Replacement comment; empty clears it, omitted preserves it; null is not allowed.
Replacement comment; empty clears it, omitted preserves it; null is not allowed.

overallRating.description: Replacement overall rating; omitted preserves it.

FunctionInput_smartrecruiters_api_key_up.description: Review and existing reviewer identifiers, with at least one replacement rating or comment.

id.description: Review identifier targeted by the update.

acknowledged.description: Provider acknowledged the update; not a read-back of stored review fields.

FunctionOutput_smartrecruiters_api_key_u.description: Acknowledgment of the review update, without reading back its stored content.

tags.instructions: Obtain reviewId and its reviewerId from `get-review` or `list-reviews`. reviewerId must match the existing reviewer and be active and authorized. Omitted rating or comment remains unchanged; comment:"" clears the comment. This cannot transfer the review to another reviewer. Success is an acknowledgment; use `get-review` to inspect stored content.

functions.name: update-user
functions.description: Partially update a company user's identity, role, language, location, external data, or SSO settings. Requires user-management authority.

language.description: Replacement account language; subscription availability still applies.

lastName.description: Replacement family name without surrounding whitespace.

location.description: Replacement location; {} means an empty location and null requests removal, subject to provider validation.

regionCode.description: Region code, recommended primarily for US locations.

firstName.description: Replacement given name without surrounding whitespace.

externalData.description: Replacement opaque external data; null clears it and empty string remains empty.

ssoLoginMode.description: Replacement user login restriction; null clears the user-level override, subject to validation.

ssoIdentifier.description: Replacement SSO identity; null clears it, subject to provider validation.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted fields stay unchanged and supplied objects replace that object's value.

FunctionInput_smartrecruiters_api_key_up.description: Company user identifier and requested partial account changes.

active.description: Provider active state, not changed by this tool's inputs.

ssoLoginMode.description: Stored user-level login restriction or null, not proof of effective company enforcement.

externalPersonId.description: Read-only managing-system person ID or null.

FunctionOutput_smartrecruiters_api_key_u.description: Stored company user fields returned by the update, with the modification instant normalized to UTC.

tags.instructions: Get userId from `list-users` or `get-user`. Omitted fields are unchanged; null clears supported nullable settings. A supplied location replaces the location rather than merging it. SSO restrictions require company-level features to be effective. This does not activate/deactivate a user, reset a password, or assign access groups.

functions.name: upload-candidate-job-attachment
functions.description: Upload a resume, cover letter, or generic file for a candidate in the context of an assigned job.

jobId.description: Job ID to which the candidate is already assigned.

contentType.description: MIME type of the original file.

contentBase64.description: Standard padded Base64 of exact bytes; public decoded maximum 2 MiB.

attachmentType.description: Attachment business category; defaults to GENERIC_FILE.

FunctionInput_smartrecruiters_api_key_up.description: One binary attachment to upload for an existing candidate and assigned job.

FunctionOutput_smartrecruiters_api_key_u.description: Metadata of the newly created candidate job attachment.

tags.instructions: Get candidateId and jobId from `get-candidate` or `get-candidate-job-application`. The candidate must already be assigned to that job. Supply exact binary content as Base64, not a multipart payload. Use `list-candidate-attachments` to inspect existing files before repeating an uncertain upload.
